title: Tabs inside a workspace
body:
herdr, which Jack is using as a reference for sessions, nests a tab level between a workspace and its panes: each tab is one split-tree layout. decade has one split tree per window today (`Layout.root` in `src/panes.rs`).

Jack wants tabs but uses them rarely, so they come after persistent sessions. When they land, today's single tree becomes the first tab, and anything saved per session has to make room for several trees.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6b9cbed5
notes.text: Jack moved this into the usability and UI round (decade-492261) as its second feature after the frame. Each tab is one split tree, as herdr does it, shown in the top bar from the frame issue. The tabs are saved with the workspace, so workspaces.toml moves to version 2 and the reader keeps an arm for version 1 under CLAUDE.md.
